name: Resolution of Intent to Suspend Professional Employees for Economic Reasons
description: Board resolution setting out the economic conditions, expected savings, other cost-saving actions, projected expenditures with and without suspensions, projected revenues, numbers and percentages of staff affected, and impact on academic programs.
deadline: No later than 60 days prior to adoption of the final budget
quote: No later than sixty (60) days prior to the adoption of the final budget, the Board adopts a resolution of intent to suspend professional employees in the following fiscal year, setting forth:
